title: THE LAST HUMAN
summary: THE LAST HUMAN | A Cinematic Sci-Fi Mystery Short Film
description:
After awakening inside an abandoned underground facility, Elias discovers a terrifying message: he may be the last human alive. As he explores the empty laboratories, strange movements and unexplained signals lead him deeper into the facility.

Then he discovers something impossible.

A chamber filled with mysterious human pods.
A figure who looks exactly like him.
And a truth that could change everything he thought he knew about humanity.

THE LAST HUMAN is a cinematic sci-fi mystery thriller exploring isolation, identity, artificial evolution, and the frightening possibility that humanity was never destroyed — it was replaced.

🎬 Genre: Sci-Fi / Mystery / Thriller
🎥 Format: AI Cinematic Short Film
🌌 Style: Dark, Cinematic, Suspenseful, Futuristic
⏱️ Duration: 60–90 Seconds

One survivor. One impossible discovery. One final question:

If humanity no longer needed you… would you still belong?

title: THE CARPENTER'S SON
summary: THE CARPENTER'S SON | A Cinematic Biblical Short Film
description:
In a quiet town of ancient Judea, a young carpenter begins to realize that his life may be part of a story far greater than himself.

THE CARPENTER'S SON is a cinematic biblical short film inspired by themes of faith, destiny, sacrifice, hope, and the extraordinary purpose hidden within an ordinary life.

Through atmospheric historical environments, dramatic cinematography, emotional performances, and powerful storytelling, the film recreates the world of ancient Judea and follows a mysterious journey that will change everything.

title: FAMILY ISSUES
summary: FAMILY ISSUES | A Powerful Emotional Short Film
description:
Family can be the source of our greatest love — and sometimes our deepest pain.

FAMILY ISSUES is an emotional short film exploring conflict, misunderstanding, broken relationships, and the difficult choices that can divide the people closest to us. Through a cinematic story filled with tension and emotion, the film shows how unresolved problems can affect an entire family — and why forgiveness, communication, and understanding can matter more than pride.

🎬 Genre: Family Drama / Emotional
🎥 Format: AI Cinematic Short Film
💭 Themes: Family, Conflict, Love, Forgiveness, Relationships

title: THE LOST STAR
summary: THE LOST STAR | A Cinematic Fantasy Adventure Short Film
description:
A cinematic AI-generated fantasy short film titled “The Lost Star,” featuring an adventurous journey through an enchanted fantasy world of mystical forests, snow-covered mountains, magical landscapes, ancient villages, and dramatic cinematic environments.

I developed the visual concept and storytelling direction, creating detailed AI prompts for characters, environments, atmospheric scenes, cinematic compositions, lighting, camera movement, and fantasy worldbuilding. The project combines AI video generation, image-to-video workflows, character direction, environment creation, cinematic framing, and visual storytelling to create a visually immersive fantasy experience.
